name: skald
description: AI voice narrator for repo activity. Polls GitHub or GitLab feeds and narrates pushes, merges, releases, and pipelines like a live commentator over your speakers. Ink terminal dashboard, pluggable LLM and TTS backends, local or cloud.

name: Workspace OSD Flash
description: DankMaterialShell daemon plugin that briefly shows the id and name of the workspace you just switched to, centered on that screen, with the windows open there. Per monitor, click-through, themed like DMS's own OSDs. Hyprland, niri, and Mango.
